failures.name: ORDINARY_SOURCE_PAYLOAD_NOT_BOUND_AFTER_LOAD
failures.observation: An externally allowlisted ordinary case was loaded successfully, then its in-memory prompt was mutated; the mutated case remained exportable.
failures.root_cause: Ordinary-source authority rechecks only the allowlisted backing-file path/blob and does not compare the exported case payload to that authenticated file.

failures.name: FORGED_ORDINARY_CONTEXT_BEARER_CAPABILITY
failures.observation: Raw heldout benchmark content borrowed the _training_export_context from a valid ordinary source and became exportable.
failures.root_cause: _training_export_context acts as a transferable bearer capability; it authenticates an ordinary file but is not cryptographically or structurally bound to the case object carrying it.

failures.name: ORDINARY_BENCHMARK_CASE_ID_COLLISION_NOT_VALIDATED
failures.observation: A byte-distinct ordinary source reusing an authenticated heldout benchmark case_id was accepted by both policy construction and policy-content validation.
failures.root_cause: Ordinary policy entries bind only path/blob identity. The builder and validator do not inspect or reserve the ordinary source's internal case_id against the global benchmark identity namespace.

failures.name: DECLARED_FAMILY_CASE_PATH_CONTAINMENT_MISSING
failures.observation: A manifest for declared family A referenced a source case under non-member sibling family B; both policy construction and materialization accepted the cross-family path.
failures.root_cause: Case-path containment is checked against the broad family_root, not the declared family directory (manifest parent), and the materializer has no equivalent family-local containment check.
